trigger: repository-native or authorized operator source acquisition

items.release_condition: Native byte-for-byte HTML or immutable official archive object is stored or receipt-linked with retrieval time, byte length, SHA-256, and transformation history.

items.object: native official hearing video or immutable official media target
items.release_condition: The HSGAC media control resolves to an authoritative stable media object or an immutable official-media receipt sufficient to reconstruct complete turns and timestamps.
An official transcript is published and receipt-linked with issuing authority, retrieval timestamp, byte length or immutable pointer, and SHA-256 when bytes are stored.

items.object: Chairman Rand Paul opening statement PDF
items.release_condition: Native PDF bytes are stored or immutable official custody is established with byte length and SHA-256.

items.object: Ranking Member Gary Peters opening statement PDF
items.release_condition: Native PDF bytes are stored or immutable official custody is established with byte length and SHA-256.

items.object: committee exhibits, subpoena/process records, witness and counsel correspondence
items.release_condition: Every object expressly used or referenced in the hearing is individually receipt-linked, or its unavailability is documented with custodian and search posture.

items.object: applicable pardon instrument and authoritative scope record
items.release_condition: The official pardon instrument and authoritative scope record are preserved with source receipts and linked to the legal-exposure chronology without interpreting the Fifth invocation as an admission.

items.object: prior sworn testimony and documentary records expressly referenced in hearing questions or opening statements
items.release_condition: Each referenced prior statement/document is preserved from an official or primary source and mapped to the exact proposition it can support or contradict.

duplicate_execution_rule: Before acquiring or mutating an object, check Issue #47 and PR #48 for an active claim on the same source family. A second lane may validate or independently review but must not overwrite another lane's custody object.
fail_closed_rule: Missing, inaccessible, or transformed sources remain BLOCKED or REVIEW_REQUIRED and cannot be silently treated as complete.
completion_condition: All objects required for exact question-level reconstruction are COMPLETE or explicitly SUPERSEDED by an equal-or-higher-authority preserved source with a durable receipt.
